segments.label: Instrument
segments.description: Camera or instrument that acquired the data.

values.AP: APXS (not covered by the camera SIS)
values.CM: CheMin (not covered by the camera SIS)
values.DN: DAN (not covered by the camera SIS)

values.RM: REMS (not covered by the camera SIS)
values.SM: SAM (not covered by the camera SIS)
values.SP: SA/SPaH (not covered by the camera SIS)

segments.label: Configuration
segments.description: Operational attribute of the instrument: A/B side for the engineering cameras, filter position or Bayer treatment for the MMM cameras, data type for ChemCam.

values.A: A-side configuration (engineering cameras) or, on Bayer / colour-split MMM RDRs, all cells with 2×2 averaging
values.B: B-side configuration (engineering cameras) or, on Bayer / colour-split MMM RDRs, blue Bayer cells only
values.R: Red Bayer cells only, or the red band of a JPEG product
values.G: Green Bayer cells only, or the green band of a JPEG product
values.F: Full colour, de-Bayered RGB merged into a single 3-band image
values.U: Upper half of the green cells only
values.L: Lower half of the green cells only
values.D: All green cells (double resolution in one dimension)
values.C: All cells, corrected for responsivity with the filter

patterns.meaning: Configuration {value}: MMM filter position, ChemCam data type or non-filter camera, per the instrument's table in SIS §6.1.1

segments.label: Special processing
segments.description: Marks off-nominal or special processing of an RDR; always "_" on EDRs.

values.T: Best tactical copy of a specially processed product

patterns.meaning: Special processing method "{value}", defined ad hoc for the sols it was used on

segments.label: Spacecraft clock
segments.description: Spacecraft clock start count in seconds, generally the time the data was acquired.

segments.label: Product type
segments.description: What kind of product this is. A leading "E" marks an EDR, a leading "N" a Nav Map EDR; anything else is an RDR.

segments.label: Version
segments.description: Starts at 0 for the image as stored onboard and increments for each copy received, which may differ in compression.

segments.label: Processing
segments.description: Ground processing applied to the camera product, one letter per step: "D" decompressed, "R" radiometrically calibrated, "C" colour corrected or contrast stretched, "L" linearized, "X" fill. All fill means no processing, i.e. an EDR.

values.XXXX: No ground processing — this is an EDR
values.DRCX: Decompressed, radiometrically calibrated, colour corrected or contrast stretched
values.DRCL: Decompressed, radiometrically calibrated, colour corrected and linearized

segments.label: Extension
segments.description: Product format.

values.LBL: Detached label for the .DAT or .IMG file
